methods.name: void logShareStarted(int eventId, String packageName, String mimeType, int appProvidedDirect, int appProvidedApp, boolean isWorkprofile, int previewType, String intent)

methods.name: void logShareTargetSelected(int targetType, String packageName, int positionPicked, boolean isPinned)
methods.comment: Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet when the user selects a target.

methods.name: void logSharesheetTriggered()
methods.comment: Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet being triggered by the user.

methods.name: void logSharesheetAppLoadComplete()
methods.comment: Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet completing loading app targets.

methods.name: void logSharesheetDirectLoadComplete()
methods.comment: * Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet completing loading service targets.

methods.name: void logSharesheetDirectLoadTimeout()
methods.comment: * Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet timing out loading service targets.

methods.name: void logShareheetProfileChanged()
methods.comment:
* Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet switching
     * between work and main profile.

methods.name: void logSharesheetExpansionChanged(boolean isCollapsed)
methods.comment: Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet getting expanded or collapsed.

methods.name: void logSharesheetAppShareRankingTimeout()
methods.comment: * Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet app share ranking timing out.

methods.name: void logSharesheetEmptyDirectShareRow()
methods.comment: * Logs a UiEventReported event for the system sharesheet when direct share row is empty.
